headline: Dusk settles on the blotter.
body: The window has gone from glass to mirror and the street is only a suggestion behind it. A page turns in another room, then nothing. We leave the lamp where it is and let the hour come to us.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: slate, one last strip of copper

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: desk lamp catching the rim of a mug
